### PM_MCQ_01: Which simple epithelium forms endothelial lining in blood vessels to permit nutrient exchange?

- A) Simple cuboidal
- B) Simple squamous pavement epithelium
- C) Simple columnar
- D) Urothelium

> **✅ Answer:** B) Simple squamous pavement epithelium
> **Explanation:** Endothelium is simple squamous pavement epithelium.

### PM_MCQ_02: Unicellular mucus-secreting goblet cells interspersed in gut mucosa belong to:

- A) Squamous epithelium
- B) Simple columnar epithelium
- C) Cuboidal epithelium
- D) Transitional epithelium

> **✅ Answer:** B) Simple columnar epithelium
> **Explanation:** Goblet cells are unicellular columnar glands.
